snippet.title: Gorescript Classic - JS / WebGL / three.js first-person shooter
snippet.description:
Gorescript Steam Page: http://store.steampowered.com/app/618690/
Free Demo: http://eepurl.com/cEkb3T
More info: http://www.gorescript.com/

Gorescript Classic:

Play (Chrome, Firefox): http://gorescript.com/classic
Add to Chrome (Chrome App): http://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/gorescript/bbohlinegjlacogbjchanihbiiboabcp

gorescript is a fast-paced '90s-style first-person shooter with an abstract 2.5D-meets-voxels aesthetic, made entirely in JavaScript / WebGL.

Built primarily as a web gaming tech demo using three.js, it's also a tribute to old FPS classics, featuring non-regenerating health, ammo scavenging, secrets, an automap, non-linear levels and strafe running.

Music by DST and 3uhox. The song used in this video is Tower Defense Theme by DST.

By the way, gorescript is open source. Fork it now on GitHub!
http://github.com/gorescript/gorescript
